modelDescription: At the foundation of the Fence Line Series lies the Howa 1500 barreled action a bolt-action powerhouse that's redefined affordability and reliability since its 1979 debut, hunters across America's diverse terrains depend on the Howa precision. Crafted in Japan by Howa Machinery with over a century of firearms heritage, this platform delivers sub-MOA accuracy (guaranteed 1-inch or better at 100 yards), hammer-forged barrels for exceptional durability and barrel life, and a crisp HACT two-stage trigger. Its 90-degree bolt throw ensures smooth, reliable cycling with dual locking lugs and a spring-loaded M16-style extractor, while the three-position safety allows unloading on safe or bolt-locking for safe transport through sprawling terrain. Featuring versatile action lengths (Mini, Short, Long) supporting all the popular calibers. The Howa1500 offers threaded muzzles for brakes-suppressors, Picatinny-ready receivers, and various stocks from lightweight coated synthetics stock options.
